name: dungeon-raze
description: A third-person melee and ranged combat prototype that runs in a desktop browser. You pick one of five classes, fight through a procedurally generated cave of looping tunnels, kill the boss in the deepest chamber and leave through the gate it opens.

scripts.dev: echo 'Visit the dev server: http://localhost:8000'; echo; python3 -m http.server 8000 -d dist
